title: Al Young as Fats Domino's unsung producer and scout
summary: Matassa credits Al Young with getting Fats Domino recorded, until Lou Chudd dropped him, and notes distributors doubled as talent scouts.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens
